definitions.explanation: Cleaning something thoroughly with water or another liquid, often in medical, industrial, or hygienic contexts. Also used as the label for the bidet/rinse function on a washlet toilet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{傷口|きずぐち}→傷口：09517_kizuguchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{洗浄|せんじょう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I rinsed the wound with water.

examples.japanese: ウォシュレット⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{洗浄|せんじょう}⟦ボタン→ボタン：02963_botan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}した→押す：02854_osu⟧。
examples.english: I pressed the rinse button on the washlet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧⟦{部品|ぶひん}→部品：00020_buhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{専用|せんよう}→専用：12385_senyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{溶液|ようえき}→溶液：15120_youeki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{洗浄|せんじょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We clean the machine parts with a special solution.

notes:
Compound of {洗|せん} (wash) + {浄|じょう} (clean, pure). A noun that also functions as a suru-verb: {洗浄|せんじょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to wash thoroughly, to cleanse). More formal and technical-sounding than everyday verbs like ⟦{洗|あら}う→洗う：00827_arau⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {洗浄|せんじょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to wash; to cleanse
- ⟦{高圧|こうあつ}→高圧：21094_kouatsu⟧{洗浄|せんじょう}: high-pressure washing
- {超音波|ちょうおんぱ}{洗浄|せんじょう}: ultrasonic cleaning
- {洗浄|せんじょう}{剤|ざい}: cleaning agent; detergent

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{洗|あら}う→洗う：00827_arau⟧: to wash — everyday verb for hands, dishes, laundry, etc.
- ⟦{消毒|しょうどく}→消毒：07591_shoudoku⟧: disinfection — emphasizes killing germs, not just cleaning
- すすぐ: to rinse — the rinsing step itself, with water only
